intro: You came. I wasn't sure you would, with all the patrols out tonight.
[t_c presses close for a moment, then glances back toward the border.]
Some nights I wish we were in the same Clan. Then I remember I'd probably drive you mad.
Did anyone see you leave? Good. Let's keep it that way.
It's been so hard trying to figure out how I feel lately.
I don't want you to get hurt, and I don't want my Clanmates to get hurt either, but the fighting hasn't slowed down. If anything, it's gotten worse! I don't know how to get through this...
[You nuzzle your cheek against {PRONOUN/t_c/inposs}, and for a moment the air is still and silent between the two of you.]
I saw you, you know? At the last battle. And I just froze. You were fighting r_c:0, and all I could think about was how sick I felt.
What are we going to do?
